questions.stem: What is meant by the quaternary structure of a protein?

options.text: The sequence of amino acids in the chain
The overall 3D shape of a single polypeptide
The arrangement of multiple polypeptide subunits in one functional protein
The coiling of the polypeptide into an alpha helix

questions.explanation: Quaternary structure refers to the way multiple polypeptide chains (subunits) are arranged together to form one functional protein. Haemoglobin is an example, with four polypeptide subunits.
